States

one model for every component
Hover · pressed

Hover shifts color or border in 300ms; pressed goes one step deeper. Fills only change tone, never size or shadow.

Focus

Keyboard only. Bordered elements turn their own border lime (one line). Filled buttons and switches get one 1px ring. Tabs and links focus on the underline.

Selected · disabled · error

Selected = deep lime fill + lime hairline. Disabled = neutral disabled tokens, never faded color. Error = danger border + message.

Enforcement

Real-time enforcement.

Millions of AI requests decided in under 10ms. Credits, limits and entitlements checked, before a single token runs over budget.

  • Runtime enforcement, locally executedDecisions happen in the request path, not after the invoice.
  • P99 < 10msFast enough to sit in front of every model call.
  • Zero overdraftHard limits stop spend before it happens.
Credits

Financial-grade credit infrastructure.

Wallets, ledgers, burn-downs, expiry rules, and priority consumption. Every edge case solved, without building it yourself.

  • CorrectnessDouble-entry integrity. Every grant and deduction accounted for.
  • Real-time balanceBalances updated in under 10ms from transaction landing.
  • AuditabilityAppend-only immutable ledger. ASC 606-compliant.
Metering

Real-time metering at 1M+ events per second.

Every token, inference call, and agent action, captured and aggregated in-request. Deploy in your VPC. Full data ownership.

  • ScalabilityMillions of events per second, across any number of customers and agents.
  • VisibilityEvery customer sees where their usage went.
Governance

Self-serve spend controls, enterprise-ready.

Per user, per team, per agent budget caps, enforced at call time, configured by your customers, not your support team.

  • BudgetsCaps per team, user and agent.
  • Enforced at call timeExceeding a cap blocks the request, with a clear reason.
Developers

One call in the request path.

Check access and usage before you serve the request. SDKs for Node, Python and React; REST and GraphQL for everything else.

Read the docsView on GitHub
const check = await stigg.getMeteredEntitlement({
  customerId: 'customer-8f2a',
  featureId:  'feature-ai-tokens',
  options: { requestedUsage: 1200 },
});
if (!check.hasAccess) return deny('budget_exceeded');
check = await stigg.get_metered_entitlement(
    customer_id="customer-8f2a",
    feature_id="feature-ai-tokens",
    requested_usage=1200,
)
if not check.has_access:
    return deny("budget_exceeded")

Deploy your way

Cloud API, BYOC or BYODB.

Cloud API

Stigg-hosted. Zero infra to manage. Connect via REST API or native SDKs.

BYOC

Your VPC, your security perimeter, your compliance posture. Fully managed by Stigg.

BYODB

Stigg writes to your schema, events flow through your SQS. You own the data layer.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Native <details> rows, hairline separated. The + turns into × when open.

What is a managed entity?
Any object in your system that Stigg makes a real-time enforcement decision for: a customer account with entitlements, a user with a subscription, an AI agent with a credit budget, or a team with a spending limit. Sandbox, test, and inactive objects don't count.
Do I have to replace my billing provider?
No. Stigg layers on top of Stripe, Zuora, Chargebee and others with a bi-directional sync, and you can switch providers later without touching your entitlement layer.
Can Stigg run in our own cloud?
Yes. BYOC deploys Stigg into your VPC; BYODB writes to your schema and event queue.
How fast are entitlement checks?
P99 under 10ms, evaluated locally in the request path.
